<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.52.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* Remove native bokeh charts support by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12964
* Add deprecation note to `add_rows` command by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13080
* Deprecate kwargs support for `st.vega_lite_chart` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13141
### New Features 🎉
* [feature] support width="content" on `st.container` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12848
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add `height="content"` to `st.dataframe` and `st.data_editor`. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12875
* [AdvancedLayouts] Add height to st.plotly_chart by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12593
* [feat] Add accept_audio parameter to enable audio recording in chat_input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12836
* [feat] Add help argument and tooltip to st.badge by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12897
* [feat] Add frontend for executing JS in st.html by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12918
* Use key as main identity for `st.file_uploader` widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12955
* Use `key` as main identity for `st.camera_input` widget by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12781
* [feat] Add microphone permission denied error handling to audio components by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12914
* Implement missing placeholder for `st.dataframe` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12968
* Show warning when hiding index in dynamic data editor by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12978
* Add deferred download button by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12942
* [feat][TextAlignment] Adds text alignment parameter to `st.text` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13032
* Add support for setting spinner as `icon` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13045
* Add support for Python 3.14 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12967
* Datetime input by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13029
* Allow configuring delta arrow in `st.metric` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12982
* [feat][TextAlignment] add text alignment for heading elements. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13034
* Support passing query params to `st.switch_page` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13027
* [feat] Add audio_sample_rate parameter to chat_input for customizable recording quality by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13054
* Add optional uvloop support for better event loop performance by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13047
* Allow configuring keyboard shortcuts on buttons by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12975
* Support passing query params to `st.page_link` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13093
* [feat][TextAlignment] Adds text_alignment parameter to markdown elements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13036
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* [fix] st.text_area negative height calculation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12891
* Fix `MultiselectColumn` issue when starting with empty rows by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12935
* Fix `MultiselectColumn` shape error when adding data by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12936
* [Fix] Font fallback & sidebar page nav font by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12948
* [Fix] Disabled widgets show border when `showWidgetBorder=true` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12949
* [fix] st.pills and st.segmented_control wrapping regression by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12969
* [fix] st.color_picker minimum width constraint by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12962
* Improve metric sparkline hovering efficiency by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12983
* [fix] st.dataframe date picker icon visibility in dark mode by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12994
* [fix] Fixes visual regression with `st.audio_input` waveform by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13010
* Bump js-yaml from 3.14.1 to 3.14.2 in /component-lib by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13026
* [fix] Do not print warning for placeholder CCv2 definitions by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13043
* [fix] st.feedback icon wrapping with minimum width enforcement by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12970
* Remove upper bound for the `packaging` package by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13073
* Fix empty Markdown code blocks rendering as “undefined” by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13074
* [fix] segmented control wrapping issue by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12879
* [fix] Ensure key is reflective of data arg in CCv2 instances by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12950
* Fix query parameters not preserved on back navigation by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13129
* Enable better file uploading on Android by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13132
* [fix] Reclassify Auth Callback Error -> Warning by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13127
* Improve `st.line_chart` hovering performance by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13156
### Other Changes
* Docs for Custom Components V2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12877
* [chore] Release v1.51.0 by [USER][bot] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12889
* Update `FormsContext` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12788
* Add `ScriptRunContext` & `ThemeContext` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12789
* Add `NavigationContext` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12790
* Add `SidebarConfigContext` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12791
* Improve phrasing of st.plotly_chart **kwarg deprecation warning  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12989
* Add enhancement proposal process by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12248
* Add support for altair 6 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13003
* [fix] Conditionally expose files/audio attributes in ChatInputValue based on accept parameters by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13079
* Reduce entry bundle size - Part 1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13071
* Reduce entry bundle size - Part 2 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13077
* Reduce entry bundle size - Part 3 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13099
* Reduce entry bundle size - Part 4 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13115
* Reduce entry bundle size - Part 5 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13128
* `StreamlitMarkdown` - module level plugin cache by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/13152
